4eGrowth · Odoo Integration Help

Official API docs: https://panel.4egrowth.com/api-doc

1) Connection (Remote Control)

Type: REST · Base URL: https://panel.4egrowth.com

connection_params (JSON):

{
  "username": "user@example.com",
  "password": "*******"
}
  • Get Token calls /api/login/ and stores bag["token"] (JWT access).
  • Get devices (plan) and Get readings send Authorization: Bearer <token>.

2) Default Procedure

  1. Get Token → obtain JWT and store it in the bag.
  2. Get devices (plan) → build bag["sensors_plan"] from device/sensor config.
  3. Get readings → call /api/data_device/{growth_id}/all_data/ with filters and upsert readings.

3) Device Configuration

In each Device (mdm.measurement.device) set remotecontrol_params:

{
  "growth_id": "DEVICE_ID_FROM_4EGROWTH",
  "start_date": "2025-01-01"   // optional fallback if the sensor doesn't define it and no prior readings exist
}

4) Sensor Configuration

In each Sensor (mdm.measurement.device.sensor) set remotecontrol_params:

{
  "parameter": "humedad",           // query filter name (see list below)
  "parameter_value": 30,            // depth or selector (e.g., 30 cm)
  "group": "Humedad suelo",         // payload group
  "key": "Humedad suelo 30 cm",     // entry under the group with a "data" array
  "start_date": "2025-01-01"        // optional; else device.start_date; else Jan 1 of current year
}

Notes

  • parameter_value may be 0 and is considered valid.
  • group and key must match exactly what the endpoint returns in all_data.

5) Time Window

  • Get devices (plan) computes initial_date per sensor: last stored reading date → else sensor.start_date → else device.start_date → else Jan 1 of current year.
  • Get readings uses initial_date → final_date = today and filters points by YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.
  • Timestamps are treated as provided by the API (UTC strings) and stored likewise.

Available query parameters (for /api/data_device/{device_id}/all_data/)

Use exactly one of these in the sensors parameter field, and set the corresponding parameter_value:

  • humedad (Soil moisture): depth selector. Example values: 20, 30, 40, all, or comma separated (API accepts lists).
  • temperatura (Soil temperature): depth selector, similar semantics to humedad.
  • potencial (Matric potential): depth selector, similar semantics.
  • clima (Weather): variable selector, e.g. eto, temperatura, or all.

Mapping examples (group/key)

  • For Soil moisture at 30 cm:
    • parameter: humedad
    • parameter_value: 30
    • group: Humedad suelo
    • key: Humedad suelo 30 cm
  • For Soil temperature at 20 cm:
    • parameter: temperatura
    • parameter_value: 20
    • group: Temperatura suelo
    • key: Temperatura suelo 20 cm
  • For Matric potential at 20 cm:
    • parameter: potencial
    • parameter_value: 20
    • group: Potencial matricial
    • key: Potencial matricial 20 cm
  • For a Weather variable:
    • parameter: clima
    • parameter_value: eto (or all)
    • group: Clima
    • key: eto (or the exact variable name returned by the API)
